stories.headline: Bessemer, Alabama traffic stop turns up nearly 60 pounds of methamphetamine
stories.body: A stop in the 5400 block of Park Avenue South in western Jefferson County produced 27,098 grams of methamphetamine and a small amount of marijuana. The driver faces trafficking and marijuana possession charges and a $706,000 bond.

stories.headline: Ecuadorian police detain three Colombians guarding a marijuana load in Carchi near the border
stories.body: Officers in Piartal, Montúfar, on October 10 spotted three Colombian men on two motorcycles escorting a vehicle and detained them. Police reported 300 plastic-wrapped packages of marijuana, equal to about 606,000 doses; the headline figure of 300 kilos is not confirmed in the body of the report.
